Pro%.d: An agency's drafted clients over drafted plus its college clients now, counted from the 2027 drafts on.

Entry+.d: Opening duels won and the rounds they swing. 100 is average, 10 is one standard deviation.

Duel+.d: Fights after the opening one: the share he wins and his kills a round. 100 is average.

Multi+.d: Rounds with two or more kills, weighted by how many. 100 is average.

Clutch+.d: How often he wins 1v1 and 1v2 rounds and what they are worth. 100 is average.

Util+.d: Grenade damage, enemies blinded a flash and flashes a round. 100 is average.

AWP+.d: Sniper kills a round and his share of the team's sniper kills. 100 is average.

Surv+.d: Deaths a round, turned over so that fewer deaths score higher. 100 is average.

Entry%.d: The share of his opening duels he won.

Clutch%.d: The share of clutch setups he won.

RAA.d: Rounds won over an average player at his level across the season: RWA times rounds over 100.

RAR.d: Rounds won over a replacement player: RWA over replacement times rounds over 100.

RD/m.d: Rounds won minus rounds lost, a map.

MVP/R.d: The share of his rounds where FACEIT named him the round MVP.

Rd MVP.d: Rounds where FACEIT named him the MVP.

Gun%.d: The share of rounds won when both teams are on a full buy.

Adv%.d: The share of rounds won with the better buy.

Dis%.d: The share of rounds won with the worse buy.

Open%.d: The share of rounds where the team got the first kill.

5v4%.d: The share of rounds won after getting the first kill.

4v5%.d: The share of rounds won after giving up the first kill.

RWA0.d: His RWA on the day he joined. Zero is an average tier-1 starter.

GF%.d: The share of the goals scored while he or the unit was on the ice.

xGF%.d: The share of the expected goals while he or the unit was on the ice.

RW.d: Wins in regulation time, the first tiebreaker.

Eff+.d: A team's Surplus on the plus scale, where 100 is the league average and 25 is one standard deviation.

$/W.d: What a roster costs above minimum players for each win of value it had last season.

AAV.d: The contract's total value divided by its years.

Gtd.d: The money he is owed even if he is cut.

LTIR.d: The cap hits of players out long term, which a team can spend past the cap to replace.

Cap%.d: The payroll as a share of this season's salary cap.

Status.d: What he becomes when the deal ends: UFA, RFA, ERFA, or a player or team option.

UFA.d: He can sign with any team when the deal ends.

RFA.d: His team can match any offer when the deal ends.

Deal.d: What his play is expected to be worth over the seasons left on his deal, aged, minus what he is paid above the minimum.

Risk.d: Cap dollars after this season that his age curve expects to buy no value.

CLASS TOP.d: The class's 10 best draft-day grades, each as the FV points over 40 that grades like his became.

CLASS DEPTH.d: Grades 11 to 50 in the class, on the same points.

CLASS OVERALL.d: The class's 50 best draft-day grades in points over FV 40, summed.

CLASS BECAME.d: The same points on the careers: the class's 10 and 50 best, whoever went where.

FA.d: His contract ends this season, and he can sign with another team after it unless his team holds his rights.

High%.d: The share of an agency's rows that come from its own page or a named report.

$.d: What signing him would cost on the NIL market, his xNIL.

Verdict.d: Extend, let walk, keep or trade: whether his next three seasons beat the replacement his money buys at his position.

Pick value.d: What a pick at that slot has returned over the cheap years at the price of a win, less its rookie pay.

vs Repl.d: His projected value over the next three seasons less what the same money bought at his position, in dollars.

Core.d: Top two on his team and top 15% in the league in projected value, 31 or under; never traded or let go.

xYrs.d: How many years his next deal should run, from age, price and position.

Mode.d: Now, window or rebuild, from the seasons his team's value under contract ranks in the league's top ten.

Fits.d: The three teams with the biggest need at his position that can take his cap hit.

OVR.d: A 0-99 grade of his overall skill from the most predictive rate in his sport: replacement 60, a median starter 75, the best in a typical season 97.

O-OVR.d: His OVR with his defense set to a median starter's.

D-OVR.d: His OVR with his offense set to a median starter's.

pWAR/82.d: His projected WAR a 60 times a starter's TOI at his position over a full season.
